Title: Azure Monitor log analytics ingestion service undergoing maintenance from October 14 – 25

Body.Content:
The ingestion service for the log analytics feature of Azure Monitor is undergoing maintenance from October 14 – 25. This shouldn't have any impact on data ingestion or usage of log analytics.

Read more information about log analytics.
